# External dependencies

## hubrpc-rust

- Upstream: https://github.com/hediet/hubrpc-rust
- Commit: `87850ef32fd2c022d91bf47f31b828d12200bb90`
- Location: [hubrpc-rust](./hubrpc-rust/)

This directory contains an unmodified snapshot of the tracked files at the
commit above, exported with `git archive`. Git metadata, ignored files, and
build outputs are not included. The source checkout was clean when copied.

Treat `hubrpc-rust` as **read-only vendored source**. Do not edit it here.
Make changes in the upstream repository, then replace this snapshot with an
export of the desired upstream commit and update the commit recorded above.

The vendored repository retains its own Cargo workspace and is excluded from
the parent workspace. The project's path dependencies point into this snapshot,
so building does not require a sibling `hubrpc-rust` checkout.
